title: lathyrus hupehensis
intro: Lathyrus hupehensis, commonly known as Chinese pea, is a perennial flowering plant native to China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus hupehensis include its ability to dilate blood vessels, lower cholesterol levels, and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
